Description: Invalid or incorrectly scoped identity token accepted by a protected service
Existing Controls: OIDC signature issuer audience expiration and role validation

Description: Insecure workload bypasses policy and reaches the cluster
Existing Controls: Protected branches CI checks OPA or policy validation RBAC

Description: Deployment identity receives excessive cluster permissions
Existing Controls: Least-privilege RBAC review and deployment audit

Description: Workload gains privileges beyond its intended runtime boundary
Existing Controls: Non-root execution dropped capabilities seccomp and NetworkPolicies

Description: CI output exposes a credential or sensitive build value
Existing Controls: Gitleaks secret isolation and sanitized reports

Description: Tampered backup is accepted for restoration
Existing Controls: SHA-256 verification reject-on-mismatch and isolated restore

Description: Excessive traffic exhausts local workload resources
Existing Controls: Network boundaries resource controls and monitoring

Description: Administrative action cannot be attributed to a responsible identity
Existing Controls: Git history audit events and pipeline records

Description: Private information is published as portfolio evidence
Existing Controls: Sanitization checklist secret scanning and review

Description: Unauthorized source or policy change is merged
Existing Controls: Protected branches pull-request review and CI validation
